text_draft: Samahani, sikusikia. Jaribu tena, sawa?
switch_points: Samahani, sikusikia. Jaribu tena, [[sawa]]?
register_note: Warm and gentle, reassuring the child there is no pressure to repeat themselves.

function_reminder: Audio was too quiet. Ask the child to speak a little louder.
text_draft: Sema tena, sauti kubwa zaidi kidogo!
switch_points: Sema tena, sauti kubwa zaidi kidogo!
register_note: Warm and encouraging, using simple direct Swahili a young child will immediately understand, with no intimidating or exam-like tone.

function_reminder: Too much background noise. Ask the child to move somewhere quieter or closer to the phone.
text_draft: Kelele nyingi! Tafadhali move karibu zaidi na simu yako.
switch_points: Kelele nyingi! Tafadhali [[move]] karibu zaidi na simu yako.
register_note: Warm and gentle, using a simple action word in English that young bilingual children in this context naturally use when talking about physically relocating.

function_reminder: The answer was unclear. Ask the child to say it again.
text_draft: Samahani, sikusikia vizuri. Sema tena, sawa?
switch_points: Samahani, sikusikia vizuri. Sema tena, [[sawa]]?
register_note: Warm and gentle, reassuring the child there's no mistake — Ntina simply didn't hear clearly.

function_reminder: The child spoke while the agent was still talking. Ask them to wait for the agent to finish before answering.
text_draft: Subiri kidogo, niache nimaliza kwanza!
switch_points: Subiri kidogo, niache nimaliza kwanza!
register_note: Warm and gently redirecting, like a patient teacher nudging a eager child to wait their turn.

function_reminder: Read a low-confidence answer back to the child to confirm it, instead of asking them to redo it.
text_draft: Ulisema "ndege" — je, hiyo ndiyo jibu lako?
switch_points: Ulisema "ndege" — je, hiyo ndiyo jibu lako?
register_note: Gentle and curious, not corrective — invites the child to confirm without pressure.

function_reminder: Alert the facilitator that repeated repair attempts have failed and their attention is needed now.
text_draft: Tafadhali ingilia kati, repair attempts tatu zimeshindwa.
switch_points: Tafadhali ingilia kati, [[repair attempts]] tatu zimeshindwa.
register_note: Neutral and direct, addressed to a supervising adult requiring immediate operational action.

function_reminder: Report a technical fault to the facilitator in plain, factual terms.
text_draft: Hitilafu ya kiufundi imetokea. Session haiwezi kuendelea sasa hivi.
switch_points: Hitilafu ya kiufundi imetokea. [[Session]] haiwezi kuendelea sasa hivi.
register_note: Neutral and factual, adult-to-adult operational tone with no affective framing.

function_reminder: Gently acknowledge that the child seems upset and say help is coming right away -- never try to continue the session first.
text_draft: Pole sana, msaada unakuja sasa hivi, subiri kidogo.
switch_points: Pole sana, msaada unakuja sasa hivi, subiri kidogo.
register_note: Soft, unhurried, and purely reassuring — no lesson language at all, just warmth directed at a distressed young child.

function_reminder: Tell the child, simply and reassuringly, that a person is coming to help them now.
text_draft: Sawa, mtu anakuja kukusaidia sasa hivi!
switch_points: Sawa, mtu anakuja kukusaidia sasa hivi!
register_note: Warm and calm reassurance, spoken gently to settle any anxiety the child may be feeling.

function_reminder: Ask the facilitator to confirm the assigned reading level before it takes effect.
text_draft: Tafadhali thibitisha level moja kabla haijahifadhiwa.
switch_points: Tafadhali thibitisha [[level]] moja kabla haijahifadhiwa.
register_note: Neutral and direct, addressing the facilitator in a professional peer tone with no added warmth or formality.

function_reminder: Report a brief factual summary of the session's results to the facilitator.
text_draft: Kikao kimeisha. Mtoto alisoma maneno 18 kwa usahihi, na alikosea mara 4 kwenye level ya phonics.
switch_points: Kikao kimeisha. Mtoto alisoma maneno 18 kwa usahihi, na alikosea mara 4 kwenye [[level]] ya [[phonics]].
register_note: Neutral and factual, peer-to-peer operational tone between the tutor system and the adult facilitator.

function_reminder: Prompt the facilitator to begin the next child's session.
text_draft: Mtoto huyu amemaliza. Unaweza kuleta mtoto wa pili sasa.
switch_points: Mtoto huyu amemaliza. Unaweza kuleta mtoto wa pili sasa.
register_note: Neutral and operational, addressing the facilitator directly with a plain factual handoff instruction.

function_reminder: Warn the facilitator that this session's recordings have not yet synced to the server.
text_draft: Rekodi za kikao hiki bado hazijasync kwenye server, mtandao haupo.
switch_points: Rekodi za kikao hiki bado hazija[[sync]] kwenye [[server]], mtandao haupo.
register_note: Neutral and factual, adult-to-adult operational tone with no hedging or child-directed warmth.
